solution.title: Microsoft Teams External Access & Guest Governance

products.name: Microsoft Teams External Access & Guest Governance — Commercial
products.short_description: Govern Teams external access & guests — external/guest/shared-channel settings, allow/block domains, guest access reviews + expiration, and sensitivity — so external collaboration is enabled and controlled. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Let people collaborate externally in Teams — safely and on policy

External and guest collaboration in Teams is powerful and risky — ungoverned, it leaks data and accumulates stale guests. This solution governs external access and guests: external access (federation) vs guest access, allow/block domains, guest entitlement and access reviews (Entra), shared channels (B2B direct connect), and sensitivity/expiration — so external collaboration is enabled and controlled.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — external access vs guest access vs shared channels (B2B direct connect), allow/block, guest lifecycle, and sensitivity.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (Teams + Entra External ID, admin roles, cross-tenant access settings, governance stakeholders).
  • Implementation Guide — configure external/guest/shared-channel settings, set allow/block domains + cross-tenant access, wire guest access reviews + expiration, and apply sensitivity — pilot-first, each policy named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic MicrosoftTeams PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (external scoped to policy, stale guests reviewed, shared channels controlled) plus Best Practices for safe external collaboration.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

External collaboration in Teams, enabled and safe — external/guest/shared-channel scoped to policy, domains controlled, stale guests reviewed out — open but governed.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • Get-TeamsExternalExposureReport.ps1 — Read-only external-exposure report: guests, inactivity, and non-approved domains, exported to CSV
    • Get-TeamsExternalGuestPosture.ps1 — Read-only discovery of Teams external-access, guest, and shared-channel posture (no changes made)
    • New-GuestAccessReview.ps1 — Create a recurring Entra access review of guests with auto-remove (expiration) - dry-run by default
    • Set-TeamsExternalGuestConfig.ps1 — Configure Teams external-access, guest, and shared-channel settings (dry-run by default; -Commit to apply)
    • Test-TeamsExternalGuestBaseline.ps1 — Validate live external/guest/shared-channel posture against a target baseline (read-only PASS/FAIL)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
